title: About
text:
I am a Python developer and data analyst with a growing focus on data science and machine learning. I currently work as a contractor with Anaconda, contributing to open-source Python projects with an emphasis on data analysis and visualization.
I previously completed an Outreachy internship with the Bokeh team, where I recreated complex visualizations from Claus O. Wilke’s Fundamentals of Data Visualization, documenting my approach through technical blog posts and translating theory into practical, reproducible workflows.
Before transitioning into tech, I worked as a pharmacist for over seven years, managing clinical operations, inventory, and patient care. That background sharpened my analytical thinking and ability to solve real-world problems under pressure — skills I carry directly into data work.

title: Projects
text:
A selection of work across data analysis, visualization, open-source contribution, and software development.


HoloViz LLM Skills
Python Open Source AI Tooling
Developed reusable agent skills and an evaluation framework to improve the quality of LLM-generated code for the HoloViz ecosystem, funded by a NumFOCUS Small Development Grant. Benchmarked common failure modes including hallucinated APIs, outdated syntax, and missing imports.
GitHub → Project Website →
Mid-project Blog Post



hvPlot Documentation Website
Python Open Source Docs
Spearheaded a complete redesign of the hvPlot documentation website, implementing the Diátaxis framework to restructure content around user needs — funded by a NumFOCUS Small Development Grant.
Built four new content pillars:
Tutorials for learning-oriented flow,
How-To Guides for problem-solving,
Explanation for conceptual depth, and
A comprehensive API Reference auto-generated from source docstrings.
Integrated the new hvsampledata package to provide reproducible, real-world datasets across all examples.
The overhaul reduced onboarding friction and unified the documentation experience across the HoloViz ecosystem.

HoloViz Website Examples
Python Open Source Docs
Revitalized the HoloViz Examples Gallery — the primary showcase for the entire HoloViz ecosystem — by modernizing 10 examples to current APIs and introducing new categories that demonstrate cross-library integration (Panel + hvPlot + HoloViews).
Updated nine legacy examples and authored one brand-new end-to-end dashboard example, ensuring every gallery entry is runnable, documented, and demonstrates best practices. This work directly supports user onboarding and library adoption by providing production-ready reference implementations.
